annotations.title: TVer広告の月額の目安を調べる

description: Use this when the user asks how much a TVer ad costs in a specific Japanese prefecture or city. TVer is a Japanese ad-supported TV streaming service. Given a prefecture and city, returns the lowest monthly rate for that area (JPY, excluding tax, guide only), the minimum campaign length and the area's population. For areas where the rate is quoted individually, no figure is returned. `allCities: true` returns only the names and populations of the municipalities in the prefecture, ordered by population, without rates. Does not return per-plan rates or audience estimates. Video production costs are not included.

allCities.description: Set true to list the municipalities in the prefecture (names and populations only, no rates).

city.description: City, ward, town or village, in Japanese (e.g. 高松市). If omitted, the most populous city in the prefecture is used.

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture, in Japanese including the suffix (e.g. 香川県).

role.description: The user's position: company = a business commissioning production or advertising / creator = a videographer, editor or other creator / agency = an advertising agency or production company.

name: get_tver_ad_monthly_rate

areas.description: With allCities: the municipalities in the prefecture, ordered by population. No rates.

error.description: Reason the request could not be answered, in Japanese.

message.description: Message for the user, in Japanese.

monthlyFromYen.description: Lowest monthly rate in JPY, excluding tax. null when the rate is quoted individually.

needRole.description: true when the call was made without `role`; nothing else is returned.

notAvailable.description: true when the tool is not available for the given role.

note.description: Notes that apply to the result, in Japanese.
